summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Little Flash ($FLASH) meme coin landing page. All major sections and features verified working correctly.

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket connection to dexscreener.com fails with 403 (expected - external service restriction), but iframe embed loads with 'Loading pair...' state. Chart may not display live data.

issues: Hamburger menu icon present on mobile - nav links collapse correctly. No issues.

critical_code_review_comments: The mascot image shown in hero section is a Flash superhero sloth (red suit), not specifically a 'baby sloth peeking' as described in user requirements - but this may be intentional branding
Dexscreener WebSocket 403 is expected behavior from external service - not a code issue
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static landing page. All sections work: Hero (Little Flash, $FLASH, tagline, 3 CTA buttons), Navbar (5 links + Buy button), Marquee ticker, Chart (Dexscreener iframe), Token Info (all 4 fields including CA copy with toast), Roadmap (4 phases A-D), Meme Gallery (3 images, lightbox works), Buy section (Jupiter link), Social links (7 links: Telegram x2, X, X Community, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram), Footer (2026 copyright). Mobile responsive with hamburger menu.
